input_fields.name: reference_plane_or_face
input_fields.description: One uniquely selected plane or planar face with an observed normal.

input_fields.name: view_side
input_fields.description: One declared front/back side of the reference plane or face.

input_fields.name: side_convention
input_fields.description: Explicit front/back-to-normal convention used to resolve the requested view direction.

result_fields.name: plane_normal_view
result_fields.description: Reference identity, observed normal, chosen side, resolved view direction, and camera result.

procedure: Resolve one plane/planar face and record its normal and side_convention.
Derive the expected view direction from view_side; do not trust a contradictory raw direction field.
Activate the verified Plan/Snap command for the selected reference and observe the camera direction.
Return plane_normal_view only when the observed side and normal agree; otherwise stop with needs_manual_review.
rejection_rules: Reject nonplanar/ambiguous reference, missing normal or side convention, contradictory side/direction, or unavailable Plan/Snap control.
Do not infer a plane normal from silhouette alone.
Do not alter the reference face or plane.
